name: seattle-open-data
description: Agent-friendly MCP server for Seattle Open Data (data.seattle.gov, Socrata SODA).

app_token.title: Socrata app token (optional)
app_token.description: A Socrata application token raises rate limits. Leave blank to query anonymously. A rejected token is reported, never silently dropped.

tools.name: seattle_data_search_datasets
tools.description: Find Seattle datasets by topic. Call first when you lack a dataset id.

tools.name: seattle_data_describe_dataset
tools.description: Decide whether and how to query a dataset: columns, live row count, data_coverage (actual time range), place fields for "in <area>" questions (with reliability), and geo columns for `near`.

tools.name: seattle_data_query_dataset
tools.description: Run a bounded read or aggregate on one dataset; paging stops at 10,000 rows.

tools.name: seattle_data_get_reference
tools.description: Read the server's reference: capability summary, SoQL help, dataset guides, and the full error catalog. Call with no arguments for the index.
